reuse.why: Extends the existing isCategoryFilled decision used by every month-wide action; setZero rewrites the categories+group query instead of reusing getAverageFillCategories' query.

duplication.why: setZero's new SQL (categories LEFT JOIN category_groups for group_hidden) is a verbatim copy of the query in getAverageFillCategories.

placement.why: The new hidden/template rule sits in the month-fill section of budget/actions.ts where the tree already centralises which categories month-wide fills write.

scope.why: Only the month-wide fill path, its queries and the predicate change.

maintainability.why: One predicate decides the rule for all actions; the leftover switch with a 'copy' branch that is now just true and the copied query are small blemishes.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All month-wide actions still go through isCategoryFilled.

disguised_duplication.where: The copied query in setZero is a plain copy, not reshaped.

one_place.where: isCategoryFilled in packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/actions.ts (hidden/group-hidden checks and hasSavedTemplates) is used by copyPreviousMonth, setZero and getAverageFillCategories.
